model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowLedger :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block ShadowBilling
        (port :in Receipt :as req)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block RemoteIndex :type "Process"
        (port :in Event)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block RemoteSync
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryPricing
        (port :in Receipt :as req)
        (port :out Command)
        (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
      (block LiveEditor
        (port :out Request :as done)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Queue
              (port :in Request :as evt)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block LiveMetrics
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
            (block EdgeSearch :type "Service"
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block Editor
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LiveRouter
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block BatchAuth
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block ShadowEditor
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block RemoteGateway
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block RemoteLedger
                    (port :out Command :as done)
                    (implements Durable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LivePlanner :type "Process"
                    (port :out Receipt :as emit)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalProfile
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowGateway
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalRenderer
                    (port :in Request)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
            (block RemoteMetrics
              (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
              (port :out Command :as done)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block Scheduler :type "Feature"
              (port :out Snapshot)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LocalQueue
            (port :in Receipt :as req)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
          (block ShadowAuth :type "Feature"
            (port :in Snapshot)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block LocalLedger
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (port :in Receipt :as evt)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeFeed
                  (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                  (port :out Request)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block BatchScheduler :type "Service"
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))
            (level
              (block BatchIndex
                (port :out Snapshot :as emit)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (block RetrySearch
                (port :out Snapshot :as emit)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeIndex
                  (port :out Receipt :as done)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeMailer :type "Feature"
                  (port :in Receipt :as evt)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeQueue
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))))))
  (level
    (block RetryFeed
      (port :in Request)
      (port :out Command :as emit)
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
    (block Planner
      (port :in Receipt)
      (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
    (adjacent
      (block LocalMetrics
        (port :in Receipt)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Sync
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
